description: Host metrics of the collector's hostmetrics receiver, from the Kinetica exporter's metric tables.

options.content:
### Hosts
CPU, memory, filesystem, network and disk metrics of the collector's `hostmetrics` receiver, per `host.name` (set by the `resourcedetection` processor). Reads the metric tables the Kinetica exporter writes, in the schema **otel**; for another schema, replace `otel.` in the panel queries. Rates assume cumulative temporality (the default of most SDKs; for delta, run the collector's `deltatocumulative` processor). Each series is averaged per minute.

panels.title: CPU utilization
panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle, across all CPUs of each host (system.cpu.time).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, host, SUM(CASE WHEN state <> 'idle' THEN series_rate ELSE 0 END) / SUM(series_rate) AS cpu_utilization
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix) AS bucket, series_id, host, state,
           AVG(sample_rate) AS series_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT p.series_id, p.time_unix,
               COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["host.name"]'), ''), 'unknown') AS host,
               JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["state"]') AS state,
               CAST(CASE WHEN LAG(p.value) OVER (PARTITION BY p.series_id ORDER BY p.time_unix) IS NULL THEN NULL
                     WHEN p.value >= LAG(p.value) OVER (PARTITION BY p.series_id ORDER BY p.time_unix)
                     THEN p.value - LAG(p.value) OVER (PARTITION BY p.series_id ORDER BY p.time_unix)
                     ELSE p.value END AS DOUBLE) * 1000
               / (MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(p.time_unix)
                  - LAG(MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(p.time_unix)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.series_id ORDER BY p.time_unix)) AS sample_rate
        FROM otel.metric_number_point p
        JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'system.cpu.time' AND temporality = 2) s
          ON s.series_id = p.series_id
        WHERE p.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    ) d
    WHERE sample_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix), series_id, host, state
) b
GROUP BY bucket, host
HAVING SUM(series_rate) > 0
ORDER BY bucket, host

SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, host, AVG(series_value) AS load_average
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, p.time_unix) AS bucket,
           p.series_id,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["host.name"]'), ''), 'unknown') AS host,
           AVG(p.value) AS series_value
    FROM otel.metric_number_point p
    JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'system.cpu.load_average.1m') s
      ON s.series_id = p.series_id
    WHERE p.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, p.time_unix), p.series_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["host.name"]'), ''), 'unknown')
) b
GROUP BY bucket, host
ORDER BY bucket, host

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: system.memory.usage in the used state, found with text_match on the series' labels.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, host, SUM(series_value) AS used_bytes
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, p.time_unix) AS bucket,
           p.series_id,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["host.name"]'), ''), 'unknown') AS host,
           AVG(p.value) AS series_value
    FROM otel.metric_number_point p
    JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'system.memory.usage'
                 AND text_match(labels, 'labels.state:"used"')) s
      ON s.series_id = p.series_id
    WHERE p.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, p.time_unix), p.series_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["host.name"]'), ''), 'unknown')
) b
GROUP BY bucket, host
ORDER BY bucket, host

panels.title: Filesystem utilization
panels.description: Used share of each filesystem (system.filesystem.usage), per host and mountpoint.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, host, mountpoint,
       SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'used' THEN series_value ELSE 0 END) / SUM(series_value) AS utilization
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, p.time_unix) AS bucket,
           p.series_id,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["host.name"]'), ''), 'unknown') AS host,
           JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["mountpoint"]') AS mountpoint,
           JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["state"]') AS state,
           AVG(p.value) AS series_value
    FROM otel.metric_number_point p
    JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'system.filesystem.usage') s
      ON s.series_id = p.series_id
    WHERE p.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, p.time_unix), p.series_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["host.name"]'), ''), 'unknown'),
             JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["mountpoint"]'), JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["state"]')
) b
GROUP BY bucket, host, mountpoint
HAVING SUM(series_value) > 0
ORDER BY bucket, host, mountpoint

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second per host and direction (system.network.io).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, host, direction, SUM(series_rate) AS bytes_per_second
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix) AS bucket, series_id, host, direction,
           AVG(sample_rate) AS series_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT p.series_id, p.time_unix,
               COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["host.name"]'), ''), 'unknown') AS host,
               JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["direction"]') AS direction,
               CAST(CASE WHEN LAG(p.value) OVER (PARTITION BY p.series_id ORDER BY p.time_unix) IS NULL THEN NULL
                     WHEN p.value >= LAG(p.value) OVER (PARTITION BY p.series_id ORDER BY p.time_unix)
                     THEN p.value - LAG(p.value) OVER (PARTITION BY p.series_id ORDER BY p.time_unix)
                     ELSE p.value END AS DOUBLE) * 1000
               / (MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(p.time_unix)
                  - LAG(MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(p.time_unix)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.series_id ORDER BY p.time_unix)) AS sample_rate
        FROM otel.metric_number_point p
        JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'system.network.io' AND temporality = 2) s
          ON s.series_id = p.series_id
        WHERE p.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    ) d
    WHERE sample_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix), series_id, host, direction
) b
GROUP BY bucket, host, direction
ORDER BY bucket, host, direction
